Author: kawaii, Ice
Name: Palantir
Punchline: Lost in a deep dungeon with nothing but dry bread and water?
Description: Palantir is a spiritual successor to PalacePal, the popular deep dungeon trap ESP plugin created by Liza Carvelli. It reveals the locations of previously recorded traps and Accursed Hoards from a crowdsourced database. Palantir also incorporates some of the mob aggro ESP features from Necrolens, by Jukka.
